---
title: "JQI_BizMoney"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}

# ============================================================
# Objective Job Quality and Perceptions of Business Leaders
#
# Question:
# Do objective employment-quality dimensions predict the extent
# to which respondents believe business leaders make money at
# the expense of ordinary people?
#
# Outcome:
#   bizmoney
#
# Original coding:
#   1 = Strongly agree
#   2 = Agree
#   3 = Neither agree nor disagree
#   4 = Disagree
#   5 = Strongly disagree
#
# Reversed outcome:
#   Higher values = stronger agreement that business leaders
#   make money at the expense of ordinary people.
#
# JQI dimensions:
#   compensation
#   benefits
#   earnings_stability
#
# Note:
# All JQI measures are assigned at the industry-year level.
# Individual-level OLS therefore treats respondents sharing
# an industry-year assignment as independent observations.
# These models are descriptive and conventional p-values
# should be interpreted cautiously.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. Packages
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)


# ============================================================
# 2. Load data
# ============================================================

gss_all <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Construct business-leaders-money variable
# ============================================================

# Original bizmoney coding:
#
# 1 = Strongly agree
# 2 = Agree
# 3 = Neither agree nor disagree
# 4 = Disagree
# 5 = Strongly disagree
#
# Reverse-code so that higher values indicate stronger agreement
# that business leaders make money at the expense of ordinary
# people.

gss_all <- gss_all %>%
  mutate(
    bizmoney_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bizmoney)),
    
    business_at_expense = case_when(
      bizmoney_num == 1 ~ 5,
      bizmoney_num == 2 ~ 4,
      bizmoney_num == 3 ~ 3,
      bizmoney_num == 4 ~ 2,
      bizmoney_num == 5 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )


# Check coding
table(
  gss_all$bizmoney_num,
  gss_all$business_at_expense,
  useNA = "ifany"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. CHECK YEAR-TO-YEAR COVERAGE
# ============================================================

# First check all years in which bizmoney is available,
# before applying the JQI complete-case restriction.

gss_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(business_at_expense)) %>%
  count(year) %>%
  arrange(year)


# Number of years in which bizmoney is available

gss_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(business_at_expense)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    first_year = min(year),
    last_year = max(year)
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Analytic sample
# ============================================================

jqi_bizmoney <- gss_all %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(business_at_expense),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits),
    !is.na(earnings_stability)
  )

summary(jqi_bizmoney$business_at_expense)

nrow(jqi_bizmoney)

n_distinct(jqi_bizmoney$year)

n_distinct(jqi_bizmoney$industry_common)


# Sample size by year

jqi_bizmoney %>%
  count(year) %>%
  arrange(year)


# ============================================================
# 6. Separate component models
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6a. Compensation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_bizmoney_comp <- lm(
  business_at_expense ~ compensation,
  data = jqi_bizmoney
)

summary(m_bizmoney_comp)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6b. Benefits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_bizmoney_benefits <- lm(
  business_at_expense ~ benefits,
  data = jqi_bizmoney
)

summary(m_bizmoney_benefits)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6c. Earnings stability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_bizmoney_earnings <- lm(
  business_at_expense ~ earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_bizmoney
)

summary(m_bizmoney_earnings)


# ============================================================
# 7. Joint JQI model
# ============================================================

m_bizmoney_jqi <- lm(
  business_at_expense ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_bizmoney
)

summary(m_bizmoney_jqi)


# ============================================================
# 8. Predictor correlations
# ============================================================

jqi_bizmoney %>%
  select(
    compensation,
    benefits,
    earnings_stability
  ) %>%
  cor(
    use = "complete.obs"
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. VIF diagnostics
# ============================================================

vif(m_bizmoney_jqi)


# ============================================================
# 10. Compare model results
# ============================================================

bizmoney_model_results <- bind_rows(
  tidy(m_bizmoney_comp) %>%
    mutate(model = "Compensation"),
  
  tidy(m_bizmoney_benefits) %>%
    mutate(model = "Benefits"),
  
  tidy(m_bizmoney_earnings) %>%
    mutate(model = "Earnings stability"),
  
  tidy(m_bizmoney_jqi) %>%
    mutate(model = "Joint JQI")
)

bizmoney_model_results


# Save model results

write_csv(
  bizmoney_model_results,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_BusinessLeadersMoney_ModelResults.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Year-specific joint models
# ============================================================

bizmoney_year_models <- jqi_bizmoney %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      model <- lm(
        business_at_expense ~
          compensation +
          benefits +
          earnings_stability,
        data = .x
      )
      
      tidy(model)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

bizmoney_year_models


# Save year-specific results

write_csv(
  bizmoney_year_models,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_BusinessLeadersMoney_YearResults.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Temporal heterogeneity:
#     Do JQI associations vary across years?
# ============================================================

# Only run these models if bizmoney is available in
# two or more years.

if (n_distinct(jqi_bizmoney$year) >= 2) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Restricted model:
  # common JQI slopes across years
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  m_bizmoney_time_restricted <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation +
      benefits +
      earnings_stability +
      factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Full model:
  # JQI slopes allowed to vary across years
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  m_bizmoney_time_full <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation * factor(year) +
      benefits * factor(year) +
      earnings_stability * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Omnibus temporal test
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  anova(
    m_bizmoney_time_restricted,
    m_bizmoney_time_full
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # 13. Focused temporal tests
  # ==========================================================
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Compensation × year
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  m_bizmoney_comp_time_restricted <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation +
      benefits +
      earnings_stability +
      factor(year) +
      benefits * factor(year) +
      earnings_stability * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  m_bizmoney_comp_time_full <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation * factor(year) +
      benefits * factor(year) +
      earnings_stability * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  anova(
    m_bizmoney_comp_time_restricted,
    m_bizmoney_comp_time_full
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Benefits × year
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  m_bizmoney_benefits_time_restricted <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation +
      benefits +
      earnings_stability +
      factor(year) +
      compensation * factor(year) +
      earnings_stability * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  m_bizmoney_benefits_time_full <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation * factor(year) +
      benefits * factor(year) +
      earnings_stability * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  anova(
    m_bizmoney_benefits_time_restricted,
    m_bizmoney_benefits_time_full
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Earnings stability × year
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  m_bizmoney_earnings_time_restricted <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation +
      benefits +
      earnings_stability +
      factor(year) +
      compensation * factor(year) +
      benefits * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  m_bizmoney_earnings_time_full <- lm(
    business_at_expense ~
      compensation * factor(year) +
      benefits * factor(year) +
      earnings_stability * factor(year),
    data = jqi_bizmoney
  )
  
  anova(
    m_bizmoney_earnings_time_restricted,
    m_bizmoney_earnings_time_full
  )
  
} else {
  
  message(
    "bizmoney is available in only one year; ",
    "temporal heterogeneity models were skipped."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 14. Session information
# ============================================================

sessionInfo()
```
